title: Sports Case
tagline: We provide a unique way for sports nfts to be displayed in a collection.
description: This project goes and searches through all of the nft sports collections  and displays them an a manner where each nft is uniquely highlighted. Our app gives your nfts collection some extra flare and really allows people to view your nfts in a way that brings out the best in the collection. In the future we also want to wrtie a filter algorithm to only show sports nfts from any collection (so if a collection has some sports nfts and some non-sports nfts we only show the sports ones).
how_its_made:
Our project is run on the polygon blockchain and uses IPFS. IPFS is used when we need to read a file on IPFS to get Metadata. We decided to use polygon because of the low gas fees.

We impressed ourselves by how well our UI/UX design was even though none of the team was that experienced in these areas.
